The 2026 ARIA Music Awards are the forthcoming 40th annual Australian Recording Industry Association music awards ceremony (generally known as ARIA Music Awards or simply the ARIAs). The ARIA Awards ceremony is scheduled to occur on was held on 18 November 2026, broadcast on Network 10 and live-streamed via YouTube and Paramount+ from Hordern Pavilion, Sydney.
ARIA Hall of Fame Event
To celebrate the 40th anniversary of the awards, with ARIA hosting a special Hall of Fame event on 11 June 2026 at Carriageworks in Sydney, with six artists to be inducted. The event was confirmed in February 2026.
The separate Hall of Fame event was first mentioned during a keynote address by CEO of ARIA Annabelle Herd, in September 2024.
